## Motivation

Each year

There aren't too many complexities to running track. Runners compete to complete the distance in the shortest time. There are many different events (distinguished usually by length) and runners typically have a specialty between distance or sprint. Distance runners need to think about pacing themselves and strategically overtaking competitors. Sprinters need to get a good start and maintain high speed for a short period of time.

## Data

Each row in the `NCAA_track` data set represents one of the top 50

There are 351 rows observed over 8 variables.

<details>

<summary><b>Variable Descriptions</b></summary>

| Variable    | Description                                             |
|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
| Place       | The runner's place for this event                       |
| Athlete     | The runner's name (Last, First)                         |
| Year        | The runner's class year                                 |
| Team        | The team the runner represents                          |
| Time        | The runner's time for this event                        |
| Meet        | The meet the time was achieved at                       |
| Meet.Date   | The date of the meet the time was achieved at           |
| Event       | What even the time is from (how many meters)            |

</details>

**Download Running Data:** [NCAA_track.csv](NCAA_track.csv){target="_blank"}
